preamble: Voicing and deaffrication of the ejective affricate [tsʼ] to the fricative [z]. In Chechen and Ingush, non-initial Proto-Nakh *tsʼ (kept in Bats) became z as part of the Vainakh voicing of non-initial ejectives. Independently, Navajo voiced stem-final Proto-Athabaskan *tsʼ to z (*wątsʼ 'roll' > -BĄ́Ą́Z), where Hupa and Jicarilla have plain s.

examples.note: Young & Morgan root notation; Ahtna baatsʼ keeps the ejective, Hupa -maːs has s.
